name: A long argument on tinted ground, beside its model
useWhen: A position needs three or four hundred words to be made honestly — a methodology, a privacy stance, a point of view — and the model it rests on has to be visible while the case is being read.

focal.note: Flat. Nothing on this slide out-shouts the argument, because the argument is the slide.

replacesNote: splits-v2 gives a colour block with a headline and a numeral. This carries the case that has to be made before a diagram means anything. Keep both.

deviations.source: filed as E-comparison / comp-colour-block in the index
deviations.why: Nothing is weighed against anything. Two of the three slides tagged E-comparison turned out to be something else, which says the family assignment needs a second pass more than the templates do.

deviations.what: claim runs into its own bullets
